name: Ollama HF-bridge pull with context-cap tag
canonical_description: Pulls a GGUF through Ollama's HuggingFace bridge, optionally capping context with a local Modelfile tag, with blob storage wherever the operator puts it.
mechanism: ollama pull hf.co/<repo>:<quant> fetches blobs (model + projector) through the HF bridge; a local tag sets num_ctx (here 131072). Verification-grade numbers come from ollama run --verbose or API metrics (eval_duration/eval_count), not from dividing visible tokens by wall-clock time; ollama ps reports GPU/CPU residency split.
constraints: A builder-local cap tag is not reproducible through Ollama server APIs by other operators.
Wall-clock division is not eval_duration; figures recorded that way stay below benchmark grade.
Ollama runtime version is versioned in the engine record's gotchas, not per-measurement.
tradeoffs: Simplest route onto a card (one pull) versus the weakest method (wall-clock) until verified.
Crowd ranges corroborate plausibility only; they are never reproductions.
re_review_triggers: Ollama changes HF-bridge blob handling or context-cap behavior.
A setup claims an Ollama-caused performance effect without a matching comparison object.
An eval_duration is recorded for a previously wall-clock-only row.

canonical_sources.locator: post 1 run report + post 2 verification decision-tree reply
canonical_sources.note: Run report plus the corpus's strongest Ollama-verification text in one thread.

note: Canonical technique identity only. A setup-specific claim must still carry its own statement, source, locator, lineage, evidence level, and contrast kind.
